units.source_text: 小野田六段追上去照拂名人。

en.t: Onoda, sixth dan, caught up with him and attended to the Master.

units.source_text: 名人夫人站在屋前泉水的石桥处迎接他。

en.t: The Master's wife stood by the stone bridge over the spring in front of the house to greet him.

units.source_text: 上午和下午，夫人都一直把名人送到对局室，看着名人在棋盘前落座了，她才迅速退下。

en.t: In both the morning and the afternoon, his wife always escorted the Master to the game room, and only after seeing him sit down before the board did she quickly withdraw.

units.source_text: 午休和中途暂停，她也一定出来迎接名人。

en.t: At lunch break and during any pause in the game, she would also always come out to receive the Master.
